//ApiKeys: At least one key of >= 16 characters is required; startup fails otherwise. Supply via user secrets or environment variables (ApiKeys__0), never in source control.
//Webhooks: Url plus a Secret of at least 32 characters, supplied via user secrets or the environment (Webhooks__0__Secret). A placeholder secret would sign every notification with a value that is public.
//WebhookDelivery: Delivery is at-least-once: every notification is persisted, retried with exponential backoff, and kept as a dead letter if it is never accepted. Subscribers must deduplicate on the envelope's eventId.
//ForwardedHeaders: The reverse proxy or container ingress in front of this service, as addresses (KnownProxies) or CIDR ranges (KnownNetworks). Only loopback is trusted by default, so without this X-Forwarded-For is ignored and every caller behind the proxy shares one rate-limit partition. Never widen it past the proxy you actually run: whatever is trusted here can choose its own client address.
//PaymentCheck: CheckIntervalSeconds x MaxConcurrentChecks must be enough to get through the watched payments; each payment costs two to three explorer requests per pass, bounded further by each currency's ExplorerRequestsPerSecond. CheckTimeoutSeconds bounds one payment's check and must stay well above the time the explorer queue takes to drain, or the same tail of payments is cancelled on every pass.

CurrencyConfigs.Name: Bitcoin
CurrencyConfigs.//AddressGapLimit: Must not exceed the gap limit the receiving wallet actually scans with, or the wallet stops discovering payments made to addresses this service issues.
CurrencyConfigs.//AmountTolerance: In satoshis. A payment within this much of the expected amount counts as exact; 0 requires an exact match and leaves a one-satoshi shortfall underpaid.
CurrencyConfigs.//Confirmations: ConfirmationsNeeded must be at least 1. Zero would settle a payment straight out of the mempool, where it can still be replaced.
